description: Implementation of the Code 2 of 5 interleaved barcode rendering class for PDFsharp library, including rendering logic, line width calculations, and code validation.

classes.name: Code2of5Interleaved
classes.description: Class implementing the Code 2 of 5 interleaved barcode, including rendering and validation methods.

methods.name: ThickAndThinLines
methods.description: Returns the pattern of thick and thin lines for a given digit.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the barcode onto a graphics context.

methods.name: CalcThinBarWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of thin bars based on size and ratio.

methods.name: RenderStart
methods.description: Renders the start pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: RenderStop
methods.description: Renders the stop pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: RenderNextPair
methods.description: Renders the next pair of digits as barcode bars.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: Validates that the input code is suitable for interleaved 2 of 5 barcode.
